incidents.name: RareStakingV1 updateMerkleRoot access check
incidents.notes: RareStakingV1.updateMerkleRoot() guarded itself with require(msg.sender != owner() || msg.sender != 0xc2F3...8ddc), a disjunction that is true for every caller, so the attacker installed their own claim root and drained the staking contract's RARE.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim is the ERC1967 staking proxy 0x3f4D74...8Eb48 (creator 0xdc005449848f65639d101a7d2b141c527e53f9d4, unrelated to the attacker); its implementation at the incident block was 0xffb512b9176d527c5d32189c3e310ed4ab2bb9ec (RareStakingV1) whose verified source contains the ||-instead-of-&& require in updateMerkleRoot; the proxy's RARE balance went from 11,907,874.71 to 0 across the attack tx
